name: 33129 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33129 (Miami) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33129 (Miami) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33129 (Miami) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).
